+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a todo app: title, description, priority Low/Medium/High, due date, mark as done, filter by status, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores todos. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/todos call them. A single HTML page lists todos with coloured priority badges, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Todo app
+
+Keep a list of tasks with a priority, a due date, and a done status, mark them off, and edit or delete them.
+
+**todos**: title (string), description (string), priority (Low / Medium / High), due_date (string), done (boolean). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add a task with title, description, priority, due date, and done status
+- List of tasks showing every field, with a coloured priority badge
+- Checkbox to mark a task as done
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every task
+- Filter the list by status (All, Open, Done)
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/todos`: Create a new todo
+- `GET /api/todos`: List all todos, newest first
+- `PUT /api/todos/{id}`: Update one todo
+- `DELETE /api/todos/{id}`: Delete one todo
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with title, description, priority select (Low, Medium, High), due date input, and a Save button
+- List of todos showing title, description, priority badge, due date, and a checkbox to mark as done
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every todo
+- Filter the list by status (All, Open, Done)
+- Show error messages from the API
